name: hivemind-ai
description: Multiplayer, multi-agent rooms: your team and a team of AI agents work on one goal, live.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "node server/server.js" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: npm --prefix client run build && node server/server.js
scripts.preview:static: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix client run preview
scripts.test: node test/swarm.test.js && node test/smoke.test.js && node test/restart.test.js
